defmodule PaymentGateway.DocumentUpload do
  @moduledoc """
  Handles document uploads for payment verification in multi-tenant system.
  Supports invoices, receipts, and compliance documents.
  """

  alias PaymentGateway.{Repo, Tenant, Document, Storage}

  @allowed_extensions ~w(.pdf .png .jpg .jpeg)
  @max_file_size 10_485_760
  @upload_base_path "/var/data/payment_docs"

  defmodule ValidationContext do
    defstruct [:tenant_id, :user_id, :doc_type, :file_meta, :validated_path]
  end

  def upload_document(conn, params) do
    with {:ok, tenant} <- authenticate_tenant(conn),
         {:ok, context} <- build_context(tenant, params),
         {:ok, context} <- validate_file_metadata(context),
         {:ok, context} <- resolve_storage_path(context),
         {:ok, context} <- enforce_tenant_isolation(context),
         {:ok, doc} <- persist_document(context, params["file"]) do
      {:ok, %{id: doc.id, path: doc.storage_path, status: :accepted}}
    else
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp authenticate_tenant(conn) do
    case get_req_header(conn, "x-tenant-id") do
      [tenant_id] ->
        case Repo.get(Tenant, tenant_id) do
          nil -> {:error, :tenant_not_found}
          tenant -> {:ok, tenant}
        end
      _ -> {:error, :missing_tenant}
    end
  end

  defp build_context(tenant, params) do
    {:ok, %ValidationContext{
      tenant_id: tenant.id,
      user_id: params["user_id"],
      doc_type: params["doc_type"],
      file_meta: extract_file_meta(params["file"])
    }}
  end

  defp extract_file_meta(%Plug.Upload{} = upload) do
    %{
      original_name: upload.filename,
      content_type: upload.content_type,
      size: get_file_size(upload.path),
      extension: Path.extname(upload.filename) |> String.downcase()
    }
  end

  defp validate_file_metadata(%ValidationContext{file_meta: meta} = ctx) do
    cond do
      meta.size > @max_file_size ->
        {:error, :file_too_large}
      meta.extension not in @allowed_extensions ->
        {:error, :invalid_extension}
      not valid_content_type?(meta.content_type, meta.extension) ->
        {:error, :content_type_mismatch}
      true ->
        {:ok, ctx}
    end
  end

  defp valid_content_type?(content_type, extension) do
    mapping = %{
      ".pdf" => "application/pdf",
      ".png" => "image/png",
      ".jpg" => "image/jpeg",
      ".jpeg" => "image/jpeg"
    }
    Map.get(mapping, extension) == content_type
  end

  defp resolve_storage_path(%ValidationContext{} = ctx) do
    # Build path: base/tenant_id/doc_type/sanitized_filename
    sanitized_name = sanitize_filename(ctx.file_meta.original_name)
    relative_path = Path.join([ctx.tenant_id, ctx.doc_type, sanitized_name])
    full_path = Path.join(@upload_base_path, relative_path)
    {:ok, %{ctx | validated_path: full_path}}
  end

  defp sanitize_filename(filename) do
    # Remove directory traversal attempts and null bytes
    filename
    |> String.replace(~r/[\x00]/, "")
    |> String.replace("..", "")
    |> String.replace(~r/[\/\\]/, "_")
    |> normalize_unicode()
  end

  defp normalize_unicode(filename) do
    # Normalize to NFC form for consistent storage
    # Handle decomposed unicode that could bypass path checks
    filename
    |> String.normalize(:nfc)
    |> String.replace(~r/[^\w\.\-]/, "_")
  end

  defp enforce_tenant_isolation(%ValidationContext{} = ctx) do
    # Verify the resolved path stays within tenant boundary
    tenant_root = Path.join(@upload_base_path, ctx.tenant_id)
    expanded_path = Path.expand(ctx.validated_path)
    expanded_root = Path.expand(tenant_root)

    if String.starts_with?(expanded_path, expanded_root) do
      {:ok, ctx}
    else
      {:error, :tenant_boundary_violation}
    end
  end

  defp persist_document(%ValidationContext{} = ctx, %Plug.Upload{} = upload) do
    # Ensure directory exists
    ctx.validated_path |> Path.dirname() |> File.mkdir_p!()

    # The doc_type parameter is used directly in path construction
    # but validated against tenant isolation check above
    case File.cp(upload.path, ctx.validated_path) do
      :ok ->
        doc = %Document{
          tenant_id: ctx.tenant_id,
          user_id: ctx.user_id,
          doc_type: ctx.doc_type,
          storage_path: ctx.validated_path,
          original_filename: ctx.file_meta.original_name,
          content_type: ctx.file_meta.content_type,
          file_size: ctx.file_meta.size,
          uploaded_at: DateTime.utc_now()
        }
        Repo.insert(doc)
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:error, {:storage_failed, reason}}
    end
  end

  defp get_file_size(path) do
    case File.stat(path) do
      {:ok, %{size: size}} -> size
      _ -> 0
    end
  end

  defp get_req_header(conn, header) do
    Plug.Conn.get_req_header(conn, header)
  end
end
